start.title: [TODO:ru] Crowds Climb the Hill
start.text:
[TODO:ru] Word spreads through the valley.
The teacher sits upon the hill.

hurry_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Pause
hurry_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Some words are worth stopping for.
Climb.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Soften
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Pride deafens the heart.
Listen first.

beatitudes.title: [TODO:ru] Blessed Are
beatitudes.text:
[TODO:ru] "Blessed are the poor in spirit.
Theirs is the kingdom of heaven."

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Lay It Down
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He blesses the meek, not the proud.
Receive his word.

mercy.title: [TODO:ru] Blessed Are the Merciful
mercy.text:
[TODO:ru] "Show mercy, and you will receive it.
Pure hearts will see God."

grudge_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Release
grudge_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Mercy untangles the heart.
Let it go.

judge_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Look Inward
judge_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Remove the beam from your eye.
Then you will see.

salt_light.title: [TODO:ru] Salt and Light
salt_light.text:
[TODO:ru] "You are the light of the world.
Let your light shine before others."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A lamp belongs on a stand.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Shine
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Salt forgotten loses its taste.
Give what you carry.

enemies.title: [TODO:ru] Love Your Enemies
enemies.text:
[TODO:ru] "Love your enemies.
Pray for those who hurt you."

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Bless Instead
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Cursing keeps the wound open.
Pray for them.

repay_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Break the Cycle
repay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Evil cannot drive out evil.
Only love can.

worry.title: [TODO:ru] Do Not Worry
worry.text:
[TODO:ru] "Look at the birds, the lilies.
Your Father knows your need."

worry_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Today
worry_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Tomorrow will care for itself.
Trust him now.

foundation.title: [TODO:ru] Build on the Rock
foundation.text:
[TODO:ru] "Hear my words and live them.
Build your house upon the rock."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Build your life on his word

sand_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Choose Rock
sand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Sand gives way in the storm.
Choose the firm ground.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Build your life on his word

ending.title: [TODO:ru] The Crowd Was Amazed
ending.text:
[TODO:ru] You walk down the mountain changed.
His words have become your house.
